theorems.name: Submission.dorag_tes_ga_graph_linear_gram_identity
theorems.statement: ∀ (n k : ℕ) (ι : Euclid n →ₗᵢ[ℝ] Euclid (n + k)) (ι' : Euclid k →ₗᵢ[ℝ] Euclid (n + k)) (B : Euclid n →L[ℝ] Euclid k), (∀ v w, inner ℝ (ι v) (ι' w) = 0) → (ι.toContinuousLinearMap + ι'.toContinuousLinearMap ∘L B).adjoint ∘L (ι.toContinuousLinearMap + ι'.toContinuousLinearMap ∘L B) = ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ (Euclid n) + B.adjoint ∘L B
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
